def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter,defaultdict
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==8]
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    pts+=marks
    a,b=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    x,y=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    obs=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if not(a<=r<=b and x<=c<=y)]
    best=None
    for sign in [1,-1]:
        for p in range(1,2*max(h,w)+1):
            d=defaultdict(Counter)
            for r,c,v in obs:d[(c-sign*r)%p][v]+=1
            err=sum(sum(t.values())-max(t.values()) for t in d.values())
            score=(err,p,sign!=1)
            if best is None or score<best[0]:best=(score,sign,p,d)
    _,sign,p,d=best
    out=[[d[(c-sign*r)%p].most_common(1)[0][0] if d[(c-sign*r)%p] else 0 for c in range(x,y+1)] for r in range(a,b+1)]
    if marks:
        r,c=marks[0]
        if r==b:out=out[::-1]
        if c==y:out=[row[::-1] for row in out]
    return out
